title: HMW DNA extraction for amphipods
author: Benoît Vacherie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b4iwqufe

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase A (100 mg/mL, Qiagen Cat #19101) to 1.5 mL Buffer G2 (Qiagen Cat #1014636) per sample.

steps.title: Lyse amphipod
steps.instruction: Place a live or flash‑frozen amphipod in a 2 mL douncer, add 1 mL of the prepared lysis buffer, and gently move the piston up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Collect lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a 2 mL Eppendorf tube; rinse the douncer with 0.5 mL lysis buffer and add the rinse to the same tube.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 75 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL, Qiagen Cat #19131) to the lysate, invert gently to mix, and incubate 2 h at 50 °C.

steps.title: Transfer cleared lysate
steps.instruction: Using a 1000 µL wide‑bore tip, gently transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL tube, avoiding the pelleted debris.

steps.title: Set up Genomic‑tip
steps.instruction: Place a Genomic‑tip 20G column (Qiagen Cat #10223) on a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Equilibrate column
steps.instruction: Apply 1 mL Buffer QBT to the column and allow it to drain by gravity.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Apply the cleared lysate to the Genomic‑tip with a 1000 µL wide‑bore tip and let it drain by gravity.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column three times with 1 mL Buffer QC each (3 × 1 mL).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute DNA into a new 15 mL tube by applying 2 × 1 mL Buffer QF pre‑warmed to 50 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1.4 mL room‑temperature isopropanol to the eluate, invert ~10 times, then centrifuge 30 min at 5,500 g, 4 °C (deceleration level 3).

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant with a P1000, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL cold 70 % ethanol using a 1000 µL wide‑bore tip, and transfer to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 min at 5,000 g, 4 °C (deceleration level 3) to pellet DNA.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Remove as much supernatant as possible without touching the pellet, then air‑dry the pellet for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 50 µL 1× TE buffer (pH 8.0) pre‑warmed to 50 °C.

steps.title: Final incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate 1 h at 50 °C, then store overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with Qubit HS; analyze 1 µL on a UV spectrophotometer (e.g., Nanodrop) and visualize 1 µL on a Tapestation to estimate fragment size.
